title: Interpretation 14-22 (City of Bellingham Building Department): single-room dwelling unit and the 120 sq ft room rule (IBC 1208.3 and 1208.4)
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by City of Bellingham Building Department (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 2012 International Building Code, Sections 1208.3 and 1208.4, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 14-22, one page; requester City of Bellingham Building Department.

Question 1: if all features of a legal dwelling are present, must the unit have habitable rooms beyond the one 120 sq ft room; can living, sleeping, eating and cooking all be in that room; must the bathroom be in a separate room.
Question 2: the efficiency dwelling unit (IBC 1208.4, 220 sq ft minimum) is not defined in the IBC; if a unit has no other habitable room, must it meet the 1208.4 size requirement?

limitations: The PDF contains the Council answer on the same page; do not present it as applicant-side input without flagging leakage.
No unit plan; the only dimensions are the 120 sq ft and 220 sq ft thresholds quoted in the question.
Edition as cited (2012 IBC); comparative only.
